title: Backend Pool Sampler
brief: Our load balancer keeps a pool of backend server ids. Servers join and leave constantly, and for every incoming request the balancer picks a backend uniformly at random from whoever is in the pool right now. All three operations sit on the request path, so none of them can slow down as the pool grows.

Implement the class BackendPool. BackendPool() creates an empty pool. insert(val) adds backend val and returns true, or returns false if it was already in the pool. remove(val) removes backend val and returns true, or returns false if it was not in the pool. getRandom() returns one backend currently in the pool, with every current backend equally likely.
